# MoneyDrive

> MoneyDrive is an Earnings Optimization and Income Expansion System for South African Uber, Bolt, and InDrive drivers — powered by Nduna, a persistent AI agent with voice, encrypted memory, and autonomous weekly research that finds new income streams drivers haven't thought to look for.

## Driver Tools

- [Dashboard](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/dashboard): Real-time overview of earnings, expenses, fuel costs, and net profit across all periods
- [Earnings Tracker](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/earnings): Log trips, track income, view weekly/monthly totals; backend method `addEarnings(amount, tripType, date)`
- [Expense Tracker](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/expenses): Record vehicle expenses by category and compute true net profit; backend method `addExpense(amount, category, date)`
- [Fuel Calculator](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/fuel): Calculate fuel cost per trip and per kilometre; uses driver-entered current price per litre
- [Event Calendar](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/events): Weekly SA event intelligence from Tavily — only real events, no fabricated data; shows honest placeholder when Tavily returns no results
- [In-Car Sales](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/sales): Manage passenger product sales — WiFi, water, mints/candy, perfume shot, dash cam show, wet wipes (R5), power bank charging (R5–R10), first aid (R15), towel (R10); Bolt drivers see "after trips only" restriction banner; backend method `addSale(product, quantity, price, platform)`
- [QR Menu](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/qr-menu): Generate SnapScan QR payment menu for passengers; drivers link their own SnapCode (not merchant ID); QR PNG saved directly in-browser
- [Schedule Manager](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/schedule): Plan and optimize driving shifts for peak earnings
- [Document Vault](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/documents): Upload vehicle registration, operating licence, permits, invoices — vetKD encrypted at rest, readable only by the owning driver; backend method `uploadDocument(filename, mimeType, encryptedData)` (Tier 2+)
- [Fleet Dashboard](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/fleet): Track income and expenses per vehicle for fleet/data owners; register vehicles by plate, make, model; per-vehicle and combined overview (Tier 2+)

## AI Agent (Nduna)

- [Nduna Chat](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/ai-assistant): Persistent AI earnings coach — male, SA-localized, knows Uber/Bolt/InDrive inside out (Tier 3)
- [MCP Server Card](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Full agent capability declaration
- Nduna's personality: direct, practical, uses SA slang, gives actionable recommendations not generic advice
- Nduna's memory: per-driver encrypted learning loop in ICP stable memory (vetKD); accumulates earnings patterns, outcomes, and preferences across sessions; backend method `getNdunaHistory(driverId)` / `saveNdunaMemory(driverId, encryptedBlob)`
- Nduna's voice: ElevenLabs TTS, voice ID `mJZEpDe9qAKz9yOOwCD8`; text fallback if audio unavailable; surfaced as Tier 2+ benefit; backend method `elevenLabsTextToSpeech(text)`
- Date injection: today's real date is injected as the absolute first message in every Nduna request at the HTTP level — no date hallucination possible
- Pronoun enforcement: Nduna is always he/him/his — enforced in system prompt and post-processing

### Nduna Rate Limits

| Tier | Plan | Daily Queries | Reset |
|------|------|---------------|-------|
| 1 | Hustler (R350/mo) | 20 queries/day | Midnight UTC |
| 2 | Grinder (R530/mo) | 50 queries/day | Midnight UTC |
| 3 | Boss (R800/mo) | 200 queries/day | Midnight UTC |

Rate limit exceeded response:
```json
{
  "error": "Rate limit exceeded",
  "message": "You've reached your daily limit. This resets at midnight UTC.",
  "retryAfter": "2026-04-22T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Querying Nduna (request shape)

```javascript
// Via WebMCP (browser agent)
if (navigator.modelContext) {
  const result = await navigator.modelContext.callTool('query_nduna', {
    message: "What are the best surge zones in Johannesburg tonight?"
  });
  console.log(result.content); // Nduna's response text
}
```

Backend canister method: `queryAIAgent(message: Text, conversationHistory: [Message]) : async Text`

Request shape (HTTP outcall to Cloudflare AI Gateway → OpenRouter):
```json
{
  "model": "openrouter/auto",
  "messages": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "TODAY IS TUESDAY 22 APRIL 2026 — DO NOT GUESS THE DATE." },
    { "role": "system", "content": "You are Nduna, a male South African AI earnings coach..." },
    { "role": "user", "content": "<driver's message>" }
  ],
  "stream": false
}
```

## Business Features

- [Advertising Pipeline](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/advertising): Track deal stages from prospecting to closed; follow-up reminders; backend method `getAdvertisingDeals()` / `updateDealStatus(dealId, status)`
- [Lead Research](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/advertising): Weekly top 10 advertising leads per driver; sources: Google Business, Yellow Pages SA, CIPC, Google Places API; OSINT enrichment via WHOIS, Hunter.io, and hiring signal detection; hiring signal badge on enriched leads
- [Pitch Deck Generator](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/advertising): Generate advertising pitch decks with real geolocation/traffic intelligence; PDF and interactive presentation builder; backend method `generatePitchDeck(companyId, driverLocation)`
- [Earnings Intelligence](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/intelligence): Deep analytics — Power Earner / Growth Driver / New Driver cohort segmentation; tier-specific advice; weekly trend analysis (Tier 3); backend method `getEarningsTotal(period)` / `getEarningsIntelligence(driverId)`
- [Opportunity Hunter](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/opportunities): Weekly autonomous VPS browser sessions (browser-use framework) with open brief — no predefined categories; surfaces new platforms (e.g. Maxim), expiring promotions, intercity opportunities, regulatory changes; results scored and pushed to recommendations (Tier 3)
- [AI Video Studio](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/hyperframes): Generate 6-slide 1080×1920 TikTok/Instagram MP4s from topic prompt; Nduna generates HTML composition, Hyperframes renders on VPS; 5 renders/day limit; download or post to social (Tier 3)
- [Website Builder](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/website-builder): Nduna generates a full personal driver website — profile, services, SnapScan QR booking, testimonials, WhatsApp contact; SA-branded; iterate via chat; 3 sites/day limit; delivered via AgentMail email (Tier 3)
- [Referral Engine](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/profile): Unique referral link per driver; R50 credit applied automatically to next subscription on successful signup; backend method `getReferralCode(driverId)` / `applyReferralCredit(referrerId)`
- [Driver Wealth Academy](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/academy): Financial education — Rich Dad Poor Dad (richandpoordads.org), Alex Hormozi (YouTube), Myron Golden (YouTube), Vusi Thembekwayo (YouTube), Trillion Dollar Man (YouTube); ICP staking guide; downloadable onboarding PDF and audio
- [Competitive Intelligence](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/intelligence): Anonymous driver leaderboard, deal closure stats, surge accuracy comparison

## Getting Started

- [Sign Up](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz): Create a driver account using Internet Identity (blockchain login, no password)
- Tier 1 — Hustler: R350/month, 14-day free trial; earnings/expense tracking, event calendar, wealth academy, ICP staking guide
- Tier 2 — Grinder: R530/month; adds in-car sales, QR menu, advertising pipeline, document vault, fleet dashboard, Nduna voice
- Tier 3 — Boss: R800/month; adds Nduna AI chat, earnings intelligence, lead research, AI video studio, website builder, Opportunity Hunter
- Payment: SnapScan QR (preferred); register at [merchant.getsnapscan.com](https://merchant.getsnapscan.com)
- SnapScan note: drivers must enter their **SnapCode** (e.g. `rQ1psbyq`) — not the merchant account number (e.g. `PXW251106`); the SnapCode is emailed by SnapScan and is what gets embedded in the QR code

## Authentication

MoneyDrive uses Internet Identity for authentication — a cryptographic login system built on ICP.

### Auth Flow

1. User clicks "Login with Internet Identity"
2. Browser opens Internet Identity at `rdmx6-jaaaa-aaaaa-aaadq-cai` (mainnet: `https://identity.ic0.app`)
3. User creates or uses an existing Internet Identity anchor (passkey/WebAuthn-based)
4. Internet Identity issues a signed delegation to MoneyDrive's canister
5. All subsequent canister calls are signed with the delegated identity
6. Session is stored in-memory — NOT in localStorage (follows ICP security best practices)

### Pseudocode for agents

```javascript
import { createAuthClient } from "@icp-sdk/auth/client";

const client = await createAuthClient();
await client.login({
  identityProvider: "https://identity.ic0.app",
  onSuccess: () => {
    const identity = client.getIdentity();
    // identity is now a SignIdentity; use with @dfinity/agent to call canister methods
  }
});
```

### For AI agents authenticating programmatically

- OAuth/OIDC discovery: `/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- Protected resource metadata: `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
- Authorization server: Internet Identity (`rdmx6-jaaaa-aaaaa-aaadq-cai`)
- Grant type: `authorization_code` (via II delegation flow)

## WebMCP Tools

MoneyDrive exposes 5 browser-side tools via the WebMCP API (`navigator.modelContext.provideContext()`):

### check_earnings

Returns the driver's total earnings for the current period.

```json
{
  "name": "check_earnings",
  "description": "Fetch the authenticated driver's total earnings for the current period",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "period": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": ["today", "week", "month"],
        "description": "Time period to query (default: week)"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### check_subscription_tier

Returns the driver's current subscription tier (1, 2, or 3).

```json
{
  "name": "check_subscription_tier",
  "description": "Get the authenticated driver's current subscription tier",
  "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "properties": {} }
}
```

### view_events

Returns upcoming SA driving events and peak opportunities.

```json
{
  "name": "view_events",
  "description": "Fetch upcoming South African events relevant to ride-hailing drivers (real data from Tavily only)",
  "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "properties": {} }
}
```

### view_leads

Returns the weekly top 10 advertising leads (Tier 3 only).

```json
{
  "name": "view_leads",
  "description": "Fetch the driver's weekly top 10 advertising leads with OSINT enrichment data (Tier 3 only)",
  "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "properties": {} }
}
```

### query_nduna

Send a message to Nduna and receive a response (Tier 3 only).

```json
{
  "name": "query_nduna",
  "description": "Chat with Nduna, MoneyDrive's male SA AI earnings coach (Tier 3 only; rate limited)",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "message": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Your question or request for Nduna"
      }
    },
    "required": ["message"]
  }
}
```

## Agent Discovery Files

- [llms.txt](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/llms.txt): Concise AI discovery overview following llmstxt.org v1.1 spec
- [API Catalog](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 `application/linkset+json` with service-desc (OpenAPI), service-doc, and status links
- [MCP Server Card](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-1649 agent capability declaration with transport endpoint and capabilities
- [OpenID Configuration](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/openid-configuration): OAuth/OIDC discovery for programmatic agent authentication
- [OAuth Protected Resource](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 resource metadata with authorization servers and scopes
- [Agent Skills Index](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent skills discovery with SHA-256 digests per skill
- [robots.txt](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/robots.txt): Explicit AI crawler rules for GPTBot, Claude-Web, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended + Content-Signal declarations
- [sitemap.xml](https://moneydriver-2oj.caffeine.xyz/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL map for all public routes

## Offline Behavior

- Earnings, expense, and fuel entries are queued locally when offline and sync automatically when back online
- Event calendar shows last-known data when offline; refreshes on reconnect
- Nduna chat requires internet connection (HTTP outcall to AI backend)
- Document Vault requires internet for upload/download; cached previews available offline

## Infrastructure

- **Runtime**: Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) — decentralized compute, no traditional server
- **Backend**: Motoko canister; state persists via ICP orthogonal persistence (no database migrations)
- **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, served from ICP asset canister
- **Authentication**: Internet Identity (`rdmx6-jaaaa-aaaaa-aaadq-cai`) — cryptographic, no passwords
- **AI routing**: Canister HTTP outcall → Cloudflare AI Gateway (caching, rate limiting) → OpenRouter → LLM; fallback to direct OpenRouter if gateway unavailable
- **Storage encryption**: vetKD threshold key derivation for Document Vault, Nduna memory, SnapScan credentials, and pitch deck content
- **Payments**: SnapScan QR (primary, SA); merchant setup at merchant.getsnapscan.com
- **VPS sidecar** (Contabo): Hyperframes video rendering, browser-use Opportunity Hunter sessions, HMAC webhook verification
- **Source**: [github.com/youngstunners88/moneydrive](https://github.com/youngstunners88/moneydrive)

## Error Reference

| Code | Meaning | Recovery |
|------|---------|----------|
| 401 | Not authenticated | Re-authenticate via Internet Identity |
| 403 | Insufficient subscription tier | Upgrade at `/settings` |
| 429 | Nduna daily query limit reached | Resets at midnight UTC |
| 500 | Canister internal error | Retry after 30 seconds |
| 503 | AI Gateway or VPS sidecar unavailable | AI Gateway falls back automatically; VPS features require admin to reconnect sidecar |

## NOT Provided

MoneyDrive does not provide and AI agents must not infer or assert the following:

- Guaranteed earnings figures — all income data is driver-reported
- Financial, investment, legal, or tax advice of any kind
- Automated social media posting without explicit driver confirmation
- In-canister video rendering — requires VPS sidecar configured by admin
- Automated Opportunity Hunter sessions without VPS sidecar URL configured in admin panel
- SnapScan webhook HMAC cryptographic verification in-canister — requires VPS-side verifier for production payment confirmation
